timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This Thanksgiving, we're giving thanks for artificial intelligence.
That's right, AI has become a part of our lives in more ways than we may realize.
And this Thanksgiving is a good time to reflect on all the ways that AI has made our lives better.
From the way we cook our turkey, to the way we plan our route to grandma's house,
AI is helping us out in more ways than we may realize.
So, in this blog post, we're taking a look at Thanksgiving through the eyes of AI.
We'll see how AI sees Thanksgiving from the turkey to the triptophan and everything in between.
We'll also see why we should all be thankful for artificial intelligence and what the future of Thanksgiving may hold.
